concerns.spots: Multiple reviewers report smaller, flatter pimples by the next morning, with reduced redness and swelling after overnight wear (e.g. [1],[3],[6],[9],[10],[13]); one reviewer [2] feels these design patches work less well on stubborn acne than Proactiv's original clear patches.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers describe the patches drawing out pus/oil and calming inflamed breakouts overnight, including one very large pustule that healed without scarring thanks to the niacinamide [4]; no reviewer reports a blemish getting worse.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note visibly less redness around the spot the morning after use ([1],[3],[6],[9]); no dissent reported.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer states the patches helped protect the skin barrier while treating the blemish [7]; this is a single mention, not corroborated elsewhere.

aspects.libelle: Discreet enough to wear under makeup
Reduces temptation to pick at skin
Weaker than original clear patches on stubborn acne

extraits.texte: Okay but Proactiv really said "cute and clinical" with these pimple patches. The Zits Happen design? Literally me every Monday morning. I've been testing them on those annoying under-the-skin drama queens that show up uninvited before content days and honestly, I'm impressed. Heress the tea: Adhesion: These stick on so well, I wore one overnight and it didn't budge. Bonus: they're discreet enough for a no-makeup day or Zoom call. Effectiveness: They're hydrocolloid, so they help flatten the spot and absorb all the ickiness. I noticed a difference in redness and swelling by the next morning. Design: Cute enough for a selfie, and I love that it adds a little humor to breakouts. It's like skincare, but with personality. Would I repurchase? Honestly, yes. Especially for stress breakouts when I need a patch that works and lifts my mood. If you want to make breakouts a little less blah, these might be your vibe. Gifted by proactiv

These are a neat idea. When you put on a patch and leave the house it's obvious anyways, might as well make it a blue butterfly. They do work well but I feel the original patches work better for more stubborn acne. I use these patches for small cover ups and it's fun and different. It makes me wish I was back in middle and high school. I would have rather had a cute little sticker on my face versus caking on coverup and clogging my pores more like I did at that age. . .

extraits.titre: reduction in redness and size of my pimples
extraits.texte: I appreciate that they're designed to be worn both day and night, providing discreet coverage while actively treating breakouts. The patches adhere well and are thin enough to be worn under makeup or alone without drawing attention. After using them overnight, I noticed a visible reduction in redness and size of my pimples, and the temptation to pick at my skin was significantly reduced. gifted by proactiv

I received this product complimentary from Proactiv in exchange for my honest review. I was so impressed by these patches! First off, they are so cute - I love the teal color and the fun little shapes. Almost as soon as I got these my skin decided to grow one of the worst pustules I've ever had - thank goodness I had these on hand to help! I thought they did a great job of drawing out the pus and the niacinamide has helped me to not have a scar from this one, which I think I really would've had otherwise. Overall, 10/10, I highly recommend, especially for how great the price is!

I received this pimple patches gifted by Proactive. These patches are some of the best I've ever tried. Once they adhere to the skin, they don't move at all. Thanks to the salicylic acid they contain, they reduce inflammation and immediately combat blemishes. The hydrocolloid helps draw out oil. Their flower, butterfly, and heart designs are fun and original. I love that it also protects the skin barrier.

I've had experiences in the past when my skin reactive badly to pimple patches. Luckily that wasn't the case with this ones. The ingredients in these patches are gentle enough to take care of my breakouts without hurting my skin. Also the design is super cute. Definitely winners here. Complimentary from proactiv
The clear zit patches work better. This one has pretty shapes.

reserve: No reviewer explicitly states a skin type (oily, dry, combination, normal, mature), so the segments section cannot be populated from this set of reviews.
